scope: Bounded priority audit; source first, candidate after release, primary proof comparisons, own published metadata only. No universal novelty certificate.

steps.status: Complete explicit comparison execution; saved native evidence, no implicit replay in default verifier
steps.coverage: Every involution of 3 letters, every word of lengths 1–7, every p <= length; numeric thresholds p,q <= 50. Algebra separately documented.

steps.step: Curated inventories and revised native evidence-only checks
steps.status: Prepared for one captured full/public execution; receipts supply actual executed status
steps.historical_version: Version1 verifier and genuine original streams/receipts remain unchanged under verification_private/historical_v1/preservation_index.json and its recorded paths.

steps.step: Adversarial root read then single seal
steps.rule: Seal once only after root reads concrete artifacts; no post-closure writes. No Git writes by auditor.

read_only_verifier: Version2 default full/public checks only inventories, pins and saved comparison/native evidence; no network, subprocesses, filesystem writes or mathematical comparison loops. Explicit comparison_check.py is separate. Private orchestration preserves exact code, argv, pre-execution pins, stdout/stderr and complete before/after priority-folder inventories.
private_artifacts: All sources_private/, search_private/, metadata_private/, verification_private/ directories; raw copyrighted PDFs/extracted text/renders and web response payloads excluded from public package.
native_capture_limits: All 53 exact query inputs are dated with explicit retrospective execution windows. The first 16 source-stage and intermediate 16 released-stage query responses remain tool-history outputs, not falsely claimed saved native payloads. Six later batches (21 queries) are saved as exact returned tool objects. Retrieval_inventory preserves actual URL/UTC/error/byte/hash outcomes; extraction/OCR limits and incomplete proof inspection levels are explicit. Original version1 native captures are preserved unchanged, including their former combined comparison/integrity behavior and former private-directory omission.
public_provenance_omissions: Raw copyrighted PDF/text/render files and access payloads
Saved native web response payloads and publication metadata/status receipts
Private orchestration, full-tree inventories and revised native integrity streams
Optional external original source and candidate16 file readbacks
manifest_protocol: PUBLIC_MANIFEST.json pins every explicitly curated public file except itself; the terminal closure pins that manifest. A separate PRIVATE_MANIFEST.json pins every static private artifact except itself and six named terminal full/public integrity streams/receipts. Those terminal native captures are internally checked when available and all are pinned in the final closure; excluding them from the pre-run static manifest avoids a self-reference cycle. Exact public filenames and exact static private filenames are checked, including rejection of extra public or unplanned private files. Public-only never requires verification_private. No seal until explicit root approval; closure is the final write.
